properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Event Hubs: No Public Access
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Event Hubs namespaces with public network access enabled. FedRAMP High requires boundary protection (SC-7). Event Hubs namespaces streaming federal data must only be accessible via Private Endpoint — public network access is prohibited to prevent unauthorized event interception and data exfiltration.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Event Hubs namespaces with public access. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
